documentTitle: Global Geopolitical Instability, Climate Risks, and Public Health Crisis Report: July 2026 Strategic Assessment

events.title: Super Typhoon Bavi (Category 5)
events.summary: Category 5 equivalent super typhoon with 165 mph sustained winds (gusts 195 mph) and 50-ft waves approaching Guam and the Northern Mariana Islands, whose infrastructure remains compromised from Super Typhoon Sinlaku (April 2026). ~210,000 residents affected; shelters near capacity; boil-water advisories active.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor NWS typhoon, flood, and coastal warnings; track utility outages and port status.

events.title: Yaracuy-Carabobo Earthquake Sequence (M7.2 / M7.5)
events.summary: Consecutive shallow earthquakes on June 24, 2026 along the San Felipe–Yumare–Montalbán fault caused massive structural collapse across north-central Venezuela: 1,450 confirmed deaths, 3,150 injuries, 12,721 displaced, 38 hospitals damaged, Maiqueta Airport closed, Caracas Metro suspended. 512+ aftershocks recorded; response transitioned to recovery with USAR teams from 29 countries.

geoScope.locality: Yaracuy, Carabobo, La Guaira, Greater Caracas

events.monitoringActions: Follow aftershock coordinates, landslide warnings, hospital capacity, and shelter updates.

events.title: European Extreme Summer Heatwave
events.summary: Record-shattering heatwave across Western, Central, and Southern Europe (France, Germany, Spain, Austria, Hungary, UK, Poland, Czech Republic, Balkans). 1,300+ excess deaths recorded since June 21, 2026 per WHO. Rail warping, reduced cooling water for thermal/nuclear plants, worsening drought, and elevated wildfire threat.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor national heat-health warning alerts; track regional water stress and grid load.

events.title: Mayon Volcano — Alert Level 3 (Effusive Eruption)
events.summary: Mayon completed its 183rd consecutive day of effusive eruption on July 5, 2026, with active lava flows, rockfalls, and pyroclastic density currents. PHIVOLCS prohibits entry into the 6-km Permanent Danger Zone. Lahar risk elevated during monsoonal rains.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor PHIVOLCS volcanic bulletins; enforce 6-km exclusion zone; track ash drift and lahar warnings.

events.title: Kanlaon Volcano — Alert Level 2 (Increased Unrest)
events.summary: Kanlaon at Alert Level 2 following two ash emission events on July 3 (47–177 minutes) with SO2 flux of 1,570 tonnes/day. A moderately explosive eruption on February 26, 2026 produced a 2,500-m plume and a 218 Pa shock wave heard 30 km away. 4-km exclusion zone in force; hot lahar risk during intense rains.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor PHIVOLCS bulletins; enforce 4-km exclusion zone; watch for phreatic explosions and lahars.

events.title: Bundibugyo Ebola Outbreak (PHEIC)
events.summary: Declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May 2026. As of July 1-2: DRC 1,460 confirmed cases / 452 deaths (Ituri epicenter); Uganda 20 cases / 2 deaths; one travel-linked case in France. No licensed vaccines or therapeutics for the Bundibugyo strain (historical CFR 30–50%). Containment hindered by active conflict in eastern DRC.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor WHO Disease Outbreak News, cross-border health screenings, and treatment center access.

events.title: Zimbabwe Mining-Linked Cholera Resurgence
events.summary: Cholera transmission resumed after a 27-day decline (one day short of WHO's 28-day closure threshold), expanding through the Penhalonga gold mining area to five districts in Manicaland and Midlands. Adults 20–40 (artisanal miners) account for over half of cases. ZRCS has reached ~124,567 people under the Cholera Simplified Early Action Protocol.
events.monitoringActions: Expand chlorination at water points; monitor WASH conditions at informal mining settlements.

events.title: Sudan Conflict-Driven Famine Risk
events.summary: 19.5 million people (41% of population) in IPC Phase 3+ through May 2026; 5 million in Emergency (IPC 4). Famine risk persists in 14 areas of Darfur and Kordofan; IPC 5 population projected to reach 200,000 by September. El Obeid under RSF siege with drone strikes on water/power infrastructure; 40% of health facilities non-functional amid cholera, malaria, and dengue outbreaks.
events.monitoringActions: Track UN human rights reports, OCHA situation updates, and humanitarian corridor security.

events.title: South Sudan Lean-Season Hunger Crisis
events.summary: 7.8 million people projected in IPC Phase 3+ April–July 2026, including 2.5M in Emergency (IPC 4) and 73,000 in Catastrophe (IPC 5). Localized famine risk in four counties through July. 420,800+ people displaced January–May 2026.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor county-level IPC food maps, displacement flows, and flood-season access corridors.

events.title: Gaza Humanitarian and Famine Crisis
events.summary: 1.6 million people acutely food insecure, including ~500,000 in IPC Phase 4 (Emergency) and 1,900 in IPC Phase 5 (Catastrophe); severe famine risk documented through mid-April 2026. Severe access restrictions and repeated displacement continue. In the West Bank, 2,300+ Palestinians displaced in 2026.
events.monitoringActions: Track OCHA OPT situation reports, crossing point status, and healthcare/WASH functionality.

events.title: Somalia Drought-Linked Famine Risk
events.summary: 6.5 million people projected at crisis hunger levels or worse in 2026, including 2M in Emergency (IPC 4); 1.84 million children acutely malnourished. Localized famine risk identified in Burhakaba District (Bay region). Driven by consecutive failed rains, record-low crop yields, conflict, and supply-chain shocks.
events.monitoringActions: Follow FEWS NET and IPC alerts, funding gaps, and child-nutrition pipeline continuity.

events.title: Northern Nigeria Acute Hunger Escalation
events.summary: 17+ million people across nine conflict-affected northern states in crisis, emergency, or catastrophic hunger (WFP, July 2, 2026). In Borno State alone: 3M+ acutely food insecure, 750,000+ in severe hunger, 10,000 in catastrophic conditions — the most severe regional food crisis in nearly a decade.
events.monitoringActions: Track Cadre Harmonisé updates, conflict maps, and aid pipelines.

events.title: Haiti Displacement and Hunger Emergency
events.summary: Record 1.5 million internally displaced by armed gang violence (IOM, June 5, 2026). 5.9 million Haitians — over half the population — acutely food insecure. Gang control of road corridors in Port-au-Prince and the Artibonite valley blocks food distribution. WFP has pre-positioned 3,300 MT of food ahead of hurricane season.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor IOM displacement metrics, port/road security, and hurricane-season preparedness.

events.title: Afghanistan Drought and Returns Pressure
events.summary: Sixth consecutive year of drought-like conditions with below-normal winter precipitation. Sharpest malnutrition surge on record: 4.9 million mothers and children projected malnourished in 2026. Compounded by population returns from Pakistan straining border host communities, and the Durand Line border conflict.

geoScope.locality: Afghanistan (border corridors: Khost, Kunar, Nangarhar, Paktika)

events.monitoringActions: Track Durand Line status, returnee flows, drought indexes, and OCHA humanitarian updates.

events.title: Ukraine Infrastructure Targeting and Sanctions Theatre
events.summary: Systematic Russian airstrikes on energy generation and transmission infrastructure, compounded by severe winter weather, have compromised municipal power and heating grids. 10.8 million Ukrainians require humanitarian assistance in 2026; ~3.7 million internally displaced. World Bank estimates reconstruction costs approaching $588 billion over the next decade. EU/US sanctions on Russia and Belarus continue expanding.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor air-raid alerts, grid status, and EU/OFAC compliance updates.

events.title: Myanmar Civil War and State Fragmentation
events.summary: 3,775,600 IDPs documented as of June 8, 2026 (Sagaing 1.34M, Rakhine 490,200). EU restrictive measures renewed April 27, 2026 through April 2027; OFAC Burma sanctions remain in force.
events.monitoringActions: Track UNHCR displacement data and EU/OFAC sanctions updates.

events.title: Lebanon Regional Escalation
events.summary: 4,298 deaths and 12,196 injuries recorded since hostilities escalated March 2, 2026 (Lebanese MoPH via OCHA Flash Update #40). Nearly 500,000 internally displaced; 47,143 in 430 collective shelters. Nearly 1 in 4 people face crisis or emergency food insecurity through August 2026.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor OCHA flash updates, ceasefire status, shelter capacity, and food security assessments.

events.title: West Asia: 2026 Iran War and Strait of Hormuz Disruption
events.summary: US-Israel joint campaign launched February 28, 2026; Iran responded with ballistic missile and drone barrages drawing in Gulf states. Iran blocked the Strait of Hormuz (naval harassment, drone swarms, sea mines), disrupting ~20% of global oil exports and triggering a global energy crisis. Pakistan-mediated ceasefire (April) and June 17 MoU established a 60-day settlement window; tensions remain extremely high.

geoScope.locality: Iran, Israel, Gulf states, Strait of Hormuz

events.monitoringActions: Monitor ceasefire compliance, Strait of Hormuz shipping/insurance advisories, and energy market disruption.

events.title: Pakistan-Afghanistan Durand Line Escalation
events.summary: Conventional border war since late February 2026. UNAMA documented 750+ civilian casualties in Afghanistan Q1 2026, including the March 16 airstrike on the Omid Drug Rehabilitation Centre in Kabul (269+ killed). Border closure has displaced 100,000+ across Khost, Kunar, Nangarhar, and Paktika and severely disrupted bilateral trade.
events.monitoringActions: Track Durand Line closures, UNAMA civilian casualty reports, and displacement flows.

events.title: Eastern DRC: M23 Control and Conflict-Mineral Sanctions
events.summary: M23 (RDF-backed) controls large portions of North and South Kivu including Goma and Bukavu. 8.2M+ displaced; 632 civilian deaths documented March 19–June 26, 2026. Financed by illicit 3TG mineral smuggling; March 2026 Rubaya coltan mine collapse killed 200+. OFAC sanctioned the Gasabo Gold Refinery smuggling network on June 25, 2026.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor UN casualty documentation, OFAC sanctions lists, and mining-site labor conditions.

events.title: Portugal Wildfire Upsurge (Storm Kristin Fuel Loading)
events.summary: National state of alert: heatwaves above 40°C, humidity below 15%, wind gusts 70–80 km/h. 1,000+ firefighters mobilized July 2; worst fire in Vouzela (Viseu). Burned area running at ~double the 2025 rate, driven by millions of trees felled by Storm Kristin left as dry fuel, especially in Leiria's pine and eucalyptus forests.

geoScope.locality: Interior North and Central Portugal (Viseu, Coimbra, Castelo Branco, Guarda, Vila Real)

events.monitoringActions: Check daily IPMA fire risk maps, civil protection notices, and interior road closures.

events.title: Bangladesh Monsoon Anticipatory Action (July–September 2026)
events.summary: AATWG activated a pre-funded monsoon flood and landslide mitigation plan with $13.84M secured, covering 287 unions and 50 upazilas across 20 vulnerable districts to proactively support ~2.27 million people with cash transfers, shelter reinforcement, and water security before peak floods.
events.monitoringActions: Monitor water level gauges, activate anticipatory cash transfers, and track landslide warnings.

structuralLayers.title: Strong El Niño Event (July–September 2026)
structuralLayers.summary: WMO projects rapid transition to a strong El Niño with seasonal-average Niño 3.4 anomaly near 2.0°C. Raises global baseline probability for extreme heat, prolonged droughts, wildfire upsurges, and heavy rainfall anomalies in H2 2026.

structuralLayers.title: Record Global Baseline Warming
structuralLayers.summary: 2015–2025 is the hottest eleven-year period on record; 2025 tracked ~1.43°C above the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline (WMO State of the Global Climate 2025).
sources: WMO State of the Global Climate 2025

structuralLayers.title: Europe: Fastest-Warming Continent
structuralLayers.summary: Severe heatwaves from the Mediterranean to the Arctic, record sea-surface temperatures, below-average flows in 70% of rivers, and record forest-burned areas. Requires permanent risk weighting for water scarcity, wildfire preparedness, and urban heat-health infrastructure.

structuralLayers.title: Africa: Accelerated Warming
structuralLayers.summary: Africa is warming faster than the global average, exacerbating vulnerability across the Sahel, Horn of Africa, and southern African drought belts where ecological fragility intersects with conflict and state fragility.

structuralLayers.title: SIDS: Existential Coastal and Marine Risk
structuralLayers.summary: South-West Pacific and Indian Ocean SIDS face existential threats: marine heatwaves covering ~40M km² of the South-West Pacific decimating reefs and fisheries, accelerating sea-level rise, and more intense tropical cyclones. Mauritius and Seychelles face outsized sovereign and infrastructure risk.
